topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got back from work, tired, and what do I find on my doorstep? A package, sealed and labeled, but not for me. How could they get this so wrong? I look at the name on the box—some guy I’ve never heard of. I've lived here for months now, and this should not be happening. I glance at the tracking slip; they should have known better. Now I have to deal with this waste of time, figure out how to send it back to where it came from. Great, just what I needed today.
